# Jungle Nepal Adventure

> Native, ethical wildlife expedition operator and tiger tracking authority in Nepal, founded by Robin Rozier and senior BBC naturalist Pawan with certified indigenous Tharu master trackers.

Jungle Nepal Adventure operates ethical walking safaris, private 4x4 jeep safaris, and wilderness expeditions in Bardia, Chitwan, Suklaphanta, and the high Himalayas. Strictly 0% captive elephant riding, 100% fair compensation for local trackers, small private groups, and conservation of wild Bengal tigers and greater one-horned rhinos.

## Core Day Safaris & Activities
- [Bardia Walking Tiger Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-walking-safari): Full-day on-foot tiger tracking in Bardia National Park with 2 senior certified Tharu naturalists (from 50€/pers).
- [Bardia Private 4x4 Jeep Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-jeep-safari): Full-day deep core exploration of Bardia National Park in an open-top 4x4 vehicle (190€/jeep).
- [Chitwan Rhino Tracking Walking Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-walking-safari): Full-day walking safari tracking greater one-horned rhinos and sloth bears in Chitwan (from 70€/pers).
- [Chitwan Private Open Jeep Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-jeep-safari): Complete UNESCO World Heritage park exploration of Kasara and Sukhibhar sectors (190€/jeep).
- [Karnali River Rafting & Wildlife Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-rafting-safari): Silent river drift through Bardia gorges with Gangetic river dolphins, gharials, and tigers (from 120€/pers).

## Flagship Multi-Day Expeditions
- [Nepal Wildlife Safari 15 Days](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/nepal-wildlife-safari-15-days): The ultimate grand wildlife circuit across Chitwan, Bardia, and Suklaphanta (2,490€/pers).
- [Bardia Tiger Safari 5 Days](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-tiger-safari-5-days): Deep immersion in Asia's premier wild tiger tracking sanctuary (690€/pers).
- [Wild Nepal Safari & Annapurna Trek](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/wild-nepal-safari-annapurna-trek): 15-day expedition combining lowlands tiger tracking in Bardia and sacred Annapurnas trekking (2,390€/pers).
- [Chitwan + Bardia Combined Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-bardia-combined-safari): 11-day complete jungle adventure comparing Nepal's two major national parks (1,890€/pers).
- [Babai Valley Wild Camping Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/babai-valley-wild-camping-safari): 4-day wild camping deep in the pristine, remote Babai valley of Bardia (790€/pers).
- [Snow Leopard Expedition Nepal](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/snow-leopard-expedition-nepal): 17-day high-altitude expedition in remote Dolpo and Mustang tracking the ghost of the mountains (4,190€/pers).
- [Himalaya Spiritual Immersion Tour](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/himalaya-spiritual-immersion-tour): 12-day retreat with meditation, sacred UNESCO temples, and mountain monasteries (2,190€/pers).
- [Rara Lake & Bardia Expedition](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/rara-lake-bardia-expedition): 17-day off-the-beaten-track expedition from deep subtropical jungle to pristine alpine Rara Lake (2,890€/pers).

## Destination Guides & Authoritative Articles
- [Where & How to See Bengal Tigers in Nepal](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/see-tigers-in-nepal): Comprehensive guide comparing Bardia vs Chitwan tiger densities, seasons, and viewing spots.
- [Bardia vs Chitwan Safari Comparison](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/bardia-or-chitwan-which-park-to-choose): In-depth comparison of landscape, wildlife density, tourist crowds, and tracking styles.
- [Walking Safaris in Nepal Safety Guide](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/walking-safari-nepal-is-it-dangerous): Rules of engagement, behavioral protocols with apex predators, and why two guides are mandatory.
- [Nepal Wildlife Field Guide](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/what-animals-to-see-on-safari-in-nepal): Complete overview of Nepal's Big 5 (Tiger, Rhino, Elephant, Sloth Bear, Leopard).
- [Nepal Safari Season & Best Time to Visit](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/when-to-go-to-nepal-for-a-safari-guide): Detailed month-by-month breakdown of weather, river sightings, and seasonal migrations.
